channel.title: Min Playtime: 20m on More Than Games
channel.description: Recent content in Min Playtime: 20m on More Than Games

item.title: Review: Elemystic (Wise Wizard Games)
item.description: When I first saw Elemystic from Wise Wizard Games, it was so small I thought it was an expansion, not an entire game. 12+, 2 players, 20-30 minutes

item.title: Review: Tacta (The OP)
item.description: Phrases like ‘tactical strategy game” and “easy to teach” don’t usually go together, but thanks to its clever graphic design, that actually works in Tacta. 10+, 2-6 players, 20-30 minutes

item.title: Review: Star Trek: Star Realms (UVS Games, Wise Wizard)
item.description: When I first saw Star Trek: Star Realms from UVS Games and Wise Wizard Games, my mental sound effects library immediately pulled up the swoosh-squeak of the original Enterprise’s doors — and, of course,“Engage!” and “Fire!” heard in several actors’ voices. 14+, 2-4 players, 20 minutes

item.title: Review: Adventure Party (Smirk and dagger)
item.description: Every fantasy adventure features the stuff of bardic songs: terrible monsters, dangerous locales, dastardly villains, and heroic deeds — and, of course, a tavern where our heroes gather and enjoy each other’s company. 14+, 3-8 players, 20-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Dodos Riding Dinos (Detestable Games)
item.description: Life was calm and peaceful on Dodino Island — right up to the point when a meteor fell on the ruling dino and dodo, leaving the island without leadership. 14+, 1-6 players, 20 minutes

item.title: Review: Boop (Smirk and Laughter)
item.description: Cats get into everything. 10+, 2 players, about 20 minutes

item.title: Review: Galaxy Trucker 2nd edition (Czech Game Edition)
item.description: When a company comes out with a new, updated version for one of their classic games, you can pretty much count on two things: the new one will cost more — sometimes a lot more — and it’ll add a bunch of complicated new features so it’s harder to learn and takes longer to play. 8+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up; 20-60 to play

item.title: Review: SpyMaster (Calliope)
item.description: A furtive glance and an almost imperceptible nod. 8+, 2-6 players, 5 to set up, 20-50 to play

item.title: Review: Funkoverse Strategy Game Series (Funko Pop)
item.description: Almost anybody in pop culture fandom immediately recognizes a Funko Pop! 10+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 20-60 minutes to play

item.title: Review: New York Slice (Bezier Games)
item.description: If you love pizza and games — and really, who doesn’t love those things — then you need New York Slice from Bezier Games. 8+, 2-6 players, 5 to set up, 20-30 to play

item.title: Review: Bärenpark Bear Park (Lookout Games, Mayfair)
item.description: City parks, theme parks, amusement parks, butterfly parks — but bear parks? 8+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 20-30 to play
